Specification: This module defines helper operators for constructing SVG element records and assembling complete SVG documents in TLA+. It models SVG graphics as records with fields such as name, attrs, children, and innerText, and provides convenience constructors for lines, circles, rectangles, text, images, groups, and root svg containers, along with a merge helper for combining attribute records. The module also includes layout-oriented helper operators such as NodeOfRingNetwork, NodesOfDirectedMultiGraph, PointOnLine, and a serialization wrapper that uses an IOUtils instance to write SVG output; several comments indicate that some functionality is intended to be supplied by Java module overrides rather than pure TLA+ definitions.
